description: Generic schema definitions and common metadata applicable across healthcare datasets.

common_fields.name: record_id
common_fields.description: Unique identifier for the individual record.

common_fields.name: source
common_fields.description: Source system or dataset from which the record originated.

common_fields.name: batch_id
common_fields.description: Identifier of the batch containing the record, when applicable.

common_fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
common_fields.description: Timestamp when the record entered the data pipeline.

common_fields.name: processing_timestamp
common_fields.description: Timestamp associated with processing the record.

common_fields.name: created_timestamp
common_fields.description: Timestamp when the source record was created.

common_fields.name: updated_timestamp
common_fields.description: Timestamp when the source record was last updated.

common_quality_requirements.completeness: Required fields must be populated according to the applicable domain schema and business conditions.
common_quality_requirements.uniqueness: Records must satisfy the applicable uniqueness constraints.
common_quality_requirements.validity: Values must conform to expected data types, formats, and allowed values.
common_quality_requirements.consistency: Related fields and records must satisfy applicable logical relationships.
common_quality_requirements.timeliness: Data should be available within the applicable operational timeframe.
common_quality_requirements.freshness: Data age should remain within the configured freshness requirement.
common_quality_requirements.integrity: Required relationships between related records must be preserved.

important_rule: Dataset-specific schemas and domain Knowledge Bases take precedence over generic common-healthcare definitions.
